hypothesis: Binance cuts the leverage / margin tiers of a single perpetual after an extreme move (often a pump or squeeze); the forced deleveraging and the end of the squeeze bring selling pressure: the same mechanism as the event short.
events: titles in research_data/binance_announcements (catalogs 49, 161, 48, 93) matching 'Update' and 'leverage' or 'margin tier', naming <COIN>USDT, not 'multiple' / portfolio margin / leveraged tokens / tick size; time = releaseDate
rule: identical to the event short's delisting leg (EL.SIZE 0.05 short from the first full hour after the announcement, HOLD 14 days, 30% stop, Bybit-listed coins only, inside the 0.5 gross cap, 10 bp per unit turnover); a coin already shorted is not doubled
